title: Example product contract

intent.owner: The person who makes the ship decision
intent.userJob: A named user completes a concrete job
intent.outcome: The user reaches the intended outcome with stated quality
nonGoals: Replacing human judgment where the rubric requires it

constraints: Keep user data within the declared boundary
Preserve the existing public interface unless explicitly changed

acceptance.statement: Given the supported input, the user can complete the named job and receives the intended outcome.
evidence: A human walkthrough of the real user path
acceptance.risk: The happy path may work while recovery or edge cases fail.

taste.reviewer: A human who represents the target user
rubric: The first-minute flow is understandable without agent narration
The result feels trustworthy and complete for the named job
Failure and recovery states are clear

release.target: The actual artifact or deployment target
readiness: The exact release artifact works in a clean consumer
Documentation and rollback path are available
rollback: Identify the last known-good version or commit
Document how to return to it
